snippet.title: Kage - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Announcement Trailer for Kage, a third-person anime action-adventure game developed by Polnoch. Players will take on hordes of enemies, hunt larger-than-life bosses, and become a legend alone or with friends in co-op. Gather loot and activate ones true power in Kage, coming soon to PC (Steam).
